answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 47349 Country: India Title: Tarawih Salah Question: (1) In one mosque the women of imam sahib offer tarawih with jamah in the house of imam sahib which is adjacent to the mosque, is it permissible to do so and can some other relatives or some neighbour women can offer tarawih with them? (2) In our society we are offering tarawih salah in 15 days in a basement of a building, can women also go there from other society to offer namaz? (3) Is it lawful to make Isha jamah before tarawih in our society instead of going to the mosque? (4) Can a Hafizah do imamat for tarawih where all women are offering tarawih? Answer ID: 47349 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1217/250/D=10/1434) (1) In order to pray salah behind imam of mosque in home it is necessary to have the rows connected. It is not clear whether this condition was met or not. (2) The women are asked to perform salah individually; it is makrooh for them to gather for salah. (3) The women should perform salah individually in their homes; therefore they are not asked to attend mosque for five times salah. (4) It is necessary to perform Isha salah in mosque with jamah. After performing Isha in mosque, the tarawih salah can be performed at any other place also. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
